# Sources

The sources of an AI reply: collapsed to "3 sources" at first, and a numbered list with the title, the site and
a short description of each when expanded. The numbers match the inline Citation markers.

**Interaction**: the header is a button: hover and press add the state layer, `Tab` shows the focus ring,
`Enter` / `Space` expand and collapse the list, and it has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Titles with a safe
address are links (other sites open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`); addresses with other
protocols are shown as text. Remote site icons are never loaded automatically.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: Sources under an AI answer, search results that back a reply, the documents behind a summary

## Import

```ts
import { Sources } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

The list is collapsed to "3 sources" at first; expand it to see the numbered sources with their site and a short
description.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return <Sources items={SOURCES} />
}
```

## Variants

### Expanded, with icons

`defaultExpanded` shows the list at once. Site icons are never loaded automatically: pass your own in `icon`.

```tsx
export function Expanded() {
  return (
    <Sources
      defaultExpanded
      items={SOURCES.map((s, i) => ({
        ...s,
        icon: (
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden>
            <title>Site</title>
            <rect width="16" height="16" rx="4" fill="currentColor" opacity={0.2 + i * 0.2} />
          </svg>
        ),
      }))}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly SourceItem[]` | The sources, in the order of their numbers (the first is 1). | — | Yes |
| `defaultExpanded` | `boolean` | Shows the list expanded at first. | `false` | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
